'''Final stage collimator barrels''' were components used in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weaponry. Usually located between the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] and [[emitter nozzle]] on selected weapons such as the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] and the [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster pistol]], the component including [[focusing coil]]s that helped the weapon maintain a cohesive blaster bolt during the firing process.<ref name="EGWT" />
